taskUse: image-semantic-personalizer training only; not text-classifier augmentation

source.reviewType: AI visual review; not human-expert ground truth
source.reviewMethod: Inspected every original/crop pair on all33 contact sheets, exact definitions displayed; enlarged uncertain crops152,328,340,344,4,59. Conservative exclusion of unclear positive evidence. No model scores used for acceptance.

splitPolicy: Train only. Every crop remains grouped with its original train parent photo and meaning; no crop is an independent photo.
labelPolicy: Each label-1 pair is an image (original parent or approved crop) matched to its meaning text embedding. Approved parents and their crops each contribute one positive semantic pair. No new negative pairs are created. Excluded legacy parent positives require separate re-audit before clean training use.

summary.rejectedParentDisposition: needs re-audit; excluded from clean positive pairs

parentBalancedTrainingWeights.recommendation: Weight each accepted parent-photo group equally, splitting its weight evenly across original and crop pairs.
